components.name: Book Button
components.description: The action a pilot wants next.
components.css: .ds-btn-book { background: #18BC9C; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #18BC9C; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-book:hover { background: #14a085; } .ds-btn-book:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(24,188,156,.5); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: General actions, including admin tools and unselected filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2C3E50; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2C3E50; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #253544; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(44,62,80,.5); }

components.name: Mine Button
components.description: Links to the pilot's own booking or reservation.
components.css: .ds-btn-mine { background: #3498db; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #3498db; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-mine:hover { background: #2c81ba; } .ds-btn-mine:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(52,152,219,.5); }

components.name: Unavailable Button
components.description: Disabled status for a slot someone else holds.
components.css: .ds-btn-taken { background: #7b8a8b; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #7b8a8b; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; opacity: .65; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions and unavailable booking windows.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #E74C3C; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #E74C3C; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #c44133; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(231,76,60,.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bootstrap form control with the theme's default focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #212529; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: #96a0a8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(44,62,80,.25); }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Full-width navy bar with white links that turn teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; background: #2C3E50; color: #fff; padding: 16px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #18BC9C; }

components.name: Slot Table
components.description: The signature booking table, with one action per row.
components.css: .ds-slots { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #212529; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-slots th { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; } .ds-slots th, .ds-slots td { padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6; } .ds-slots tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.075); } .ds-slots abbr { text-decoration: underline dotted; } .ds-slots-book { background: #18BC9C; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #18BC9C; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slots-book:hover { background: #14a085; } .ds-slots-book:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(24,188,156,.5); }

components.name: Action Bar
components.description: Bulk actions above admin tables, stating the count and who is affected.
components.html: 3 bookings selected 2 pilots are affected and get an email if you delete.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: #2C3E50; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-bar-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-bar button { background: #ecf0f1; color: #212529; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font: inherit; font-size: .875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bar button:hover { background: #dde3e4; } .ds-bar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-bar .ds-bar-danger { background: #E74C3C; color: #fff; } .ds-bar .ds-bar-danger:hover { background: #c44133; }

narrative.overview:
BMAC reads like a departures board: slots are rows to scan, status is readable at a glance, and each row leads to one clear action. The mood is precise and operational. It uses aviation's own terms, Zulu times and exact counts, and it says what an action will affect before the action runs.

Components are compact and scannable, built on stock Bootstrap with the Bootswatch Flatly theme. Short labels and tight rows do the work, not custom controls. Pages are a navy navbar, a white body and a single centred container, with no decoration beyond the division's logo and event images.

This is the default identity. Each division can swap its name, logos and six theme colours at build time, so the values below are defaults and not fixed brand colours.
keyCharacteristics: Stock Bootstrap 5 components with the Flatly theme.
Flat white pages, with tables as the main working surface.
Status and consequences stated in exact words and counts.
Colours come from theme variables, so any division can replace them.

rules.name: The Swappable Colour Rule
rules.body: Use Bootstrap theme classes and Sass variables, never literal hex values, because divisions set primary, secondary, tertiary, success, warning and danger through `BOOTSTRAP_COLOR_*` at build time.

rules.name: The Status Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal means available. On pilot tables, blue means yours, slate means taken and red means not available. On admin tables, Open is teal, Reserved is amber and Booked is neutral. Status always carries a text label as well as colour.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only Lato 400 and 700 are loaded, so use those two weights. Other values resolve to one of them, including the navbar brand's 800, which renders at 700.

rules.name: The Zulu Time Rule
rules.body: Show times in 24-hour format with a `z` suffix, as in `18:00z` or `1800z`.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces stay flat at rest. Only floating layers such as dropdowns and modals get a shadow.

dos: Do reach for Bootstrap components and existing `x-forms.*` components before writing custom ones.
Do use theme classes such as `btn-success` and `text-primary` so division colours apply.
Do state exact counts and who is affected before a bulk or destructive action runs.
Do keep status readable as words, not colour alone.
Do test new interface with different division colours, logos and rich-text event content.
donts: Don't hard-code colours, logos or a division name.
Don't add shadows to content surfaces at rest.
Don't load extra Lato weights or a second typeface without changing this document.
Don't add fade to Livewire-driven Bootstrap modals, because Bootstrap ignores show and hide during a transition.
Don't treat the current default contrast as a target for new text. White on Go Teal (about 2.4:1) and Overcast Grey links on white (about 2.6:1) fall below WCAG AA.
